Hey [Neighbor's Name],

Hope you're doing well! Just wanted to drop you a quick note to tell you about something really nice I saw on your street today. There are some lovely wildflowers growing near the fence between our properties. They're this beautiful shade of purple and yellow, and they add such a cheerful touch to the neighborhood.

I was walking the dog and couldn't help but stop to admire them for a bit. It's always a bright spot to see something so vibrant and carefree in the middle of the city.

Thought I'd let you know since you're usually the first to spot these things. Maybe we could discuss them next time we chat and see if anyone remembers planting them or if they just appeared naturally. Either way, they're a joy to behold!

Take care and keep an eye out for more beauties like these
